```{python}
#| context: setup
#| message: false
from pathlib import Path

import folium
import geopandas as gpd
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from branca.colormap import linear
from shiny import reactive, render, req, ui


import importlib
import geopandas as gpd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pandas as pd
from pathlib import Path
import yaml
import pyarrow
import pycountry

import healthcare_accessibility.geospatial_utils as geo_util
import healthcare_accessibility.osm_utils as osm_util
import healthcare_accessibility.data_processing_funcs as dp_funcs
import healthcare_accessibility.utils as utils
import healthcare_accessibility.postprocessing as postpro


config_filepath = Path().cwd().joinpath("configs", "config.yaml")

with open(config_filepath) as file:
    config = yaml.safe_load(file)

with open(config.get("datasets_config")) as file:
    datasets = yaml.safe_load(file)


facility_type_col_header = "facility_type"
admin_area_col_header = "ADM2"
travel_metric_header = "travel_distance"
facility_name_header = "facility_name"
grid_id_header = "grid_id"

analysis_crs = config.get("analysis_crs").get(config.get("country"))
visualisation_crs = config.get("visualisation_crs")

country = config.get("country")

travel_time_inputs_dir = Path(config.get("outputs_dir")).joinpath(country)

bike_ttm_df = pyarrow.parquet.read_pandas(
    Path(travel_time_inputs_dir).joinpath(
        "bicycle_travel_times_to_All healthcare facilities.parquet"
    )
).to_pandas()
bike_ttm_df["to_id"] = bike_ttm_df["to_id"].astype(str)


walk_ttm_path = Path(travel_time_inputs_dir).joinpath(
    "walk_travel_times_to_All healthcare facilities.parquet"
)
if walk_ttm_path.exists():
    walk_ttm_df = pyarrow.parquet.read_pandas(
        Path(travel_time_inputs_dir).joinpath(
            "walk_travel_times_to_All healthcare facilities.parquet"
        )
    ).to_pandas()
    walk_ttm_df["to_id"] = walk_ttm_df["to_id"].astype(str)


car_ttm_path = Path(travel_time_inputs_dir).joinpath(
    "car_travel_times_to_All healthcare facilities.parquet"
)
if car_ttm_path.exists():
    car_ttm_df = pyarrow.parquet.read_pandas(
        Path(travel_time_inputs_dir).joinpath(
            "car_travel_times_to_All healthcare facilities.parquet"
        )
    ).to_pandas()
    car_ttm_df["to_id"] = car_ttm_df["to_id"].astype(str)


processed_data_dir = (
    Path(config.get("data_dir")) / config.get("country") / "processed_data"
)

health_fac_gdf = gpd.read_file(
    processed_data_dir / datasets.get("health_facility").get("processed_hcf")
)

health_fac_gdf = health_fac_gdf.to_crs(analysis_crs)

# convert any polygons to points by taking the centroid (some facilities are mapped as polygons in OSM)
health_fac_gdf["geometry"] = health_fac_gdf.geometry.centroid

healthcare = health_fac_gdf[["id", facility_type_col_header, facility_name_header, "facility_ownership", "geometry"]]


pop_gdf = gpd.read_file(
    processed_data_dir / datasets.get("population").get("processed_master_grid")
)

pop_gdf = pop_gdf.rename(columns={"id_national": "id"})
pop_gdf = pop_gdf.to_crs(analysis_crs)


adm2_path = (
    Path(config.get("data_dir"))
    .joinpath(country.lower())
    .joinpath("raw_data")
    .joinpath("admin_boundary_geom")
    .joinpath(
        f"{pycountry.countries.get(name=country).alpha_3}_ADM2_geoboundaries.geojson"
    )
)

district_gdf = dp_funcs.load_administrative_boundaries(adm2_path, "ADM2", message=False)
district_gdf = district_gdf.to_crs(analysis_crs)


distance_matrix_bike_df = postpro.convert_travel_time_to_distance(
    bike_ttm_df, "bicycle"
)

distance_matrix_df = distance_matrix_bike_df.drop("travel_time", axis=1)

ttm_gdf = distance_matrix_df.merge(pop_gdf, left_on="to_id", right_on="id", how="right")
ttm_gdf = ttm_gdf.merge(healthcare.drop("geometry",axis=1), left_on="from_id", right_on="id", how="left")
ttm_gdf = ttm_gdf.rename(columns={"to_id": grid_id_header, "from_id": "hcf_id"})


demographic_dict = {
    "population": "Total population",
    "female": "Females",
    "male": "Males",
    "children": "Children (0-14)",
    "working_age": "Working-age adults (15-64)",
    "older_people": "Older people (65+)",
    "reproductive_age": "Women of reproductive age (15-49)",
}

healthcare_admin = gpd.sjoin(  
    healthcare[["id", "geometry"]],  
    district_gdf[[admin_area_col_header, "geometry"]],  
    how="left",  
    predicate="intersects",  
)[["id", admin_area_col_header]].drop_duplicates(subset="id")  

```


# {.sidebar}

Explore the estimated populations that are within the chosen distance of a healthcare facility.

```{python}

ui.input_select(
    "admin_area",
    "Select an admin area",
    choices=["National", *sorted(district_gdf[admin_area_col_header].dropna().unique().tolist())],
    selected="National",
)

ui.input_selectize(
    "facility_type_selection",
    "Select health facility type(s)",
    choices=sorted(healthcare[facility_type_col_header].dropna().unique().tolist()),
    selected=["hospital"],
    multiple=True,
)

ui.input_numeric(
    "distance_band_km",
    "Select distance threshold (km)",
    value=10,
    min=1,
    max=20,
    step=1,
)

ui.input_select(
    "demographic",
    "Select demographic group",
    choices=demographic_dict,
    selected=demographic_dict.get("population"),
)

ui.input_checkbox(
    "show_outside",
    "Show population outside selected distance",
    value=True,
)

ui.input_action_button("show_facility_modal", "Show health facility breakdown")
```

```{python}

@reactive.calc
def selected_district() -> gpd.GeoDataFrame:
    if input.admin_area() == "National":
        return district_gdf
    return gpd.GeoDataFrame(district_gdf.loc[district_gdf[admin_area_col_header] == input.admin_area()].copy())


@reactive.calc
def selected_facility_types() -> list[str]:
    values = input.facility_type_selection()
    if values is None:
        return []
    if isinstance(values, str):
        return [values]
    return list(values)


@reactive.calc
def filtered_healthcare() -> pd.DataFrame:
    types = selected_facility_types()
    df = healthcare.loc[healthcare[facility_type_col_header].isin(types)].copy()
    df = df.merge(healthcare_admin, on="id", how="left")

    if input.admin_area() != "National":
        df = df.loc[df[admin_area_col_header] == input.admin_area()].copy()  


    popup_exclude = {"id", "geometry"}
    popup_cols = [c for c in df.columns if c not in popup_exclude]

    def build_popup(row: pd.Series) -> str:
        name = row.get(facility_name_header, "Facility")
        details = [f"{col}: {row[col]}" for col in popup_cols if col != facility_name_header]
        return f"<b>{name}</b><br>" + "<br>".join(details)

    if not df.empty:
        df["popup"] = df.apply(build_popup, axis=1)
    else:
        df["popup"] = []
    return df


@reactive.calc
def ttm_filtered() -> pd.DataFrame:
    types = selected_facility_types()

    if input.admin_area() == "National":
        mask = ttm_gdf[facility_type_col_header].isna() | ttm_gdf[facility_type_col_header].isin(types)
        return ttm_gdf.loc[mask].copy()
    else:
        mask = (ttm_gdf[admin_area_col_header].isna() | (ttm_gdf[admin_area_col_header] == input.admin_area())) & (
        ttm_gdf[facility_type_col_header].isna() | ttm_gdf[facility_type_col_header].isin(types)
    )
        return ttm_gdf.loc[mask].copy()


@reactive.calc
def point_population() -> pd.DataFrame:
    """ Return grid cells that meet input conditions."""
    demo_col = input.demographic()
    req(demo_col in ttm_gdf.columns)

    grouped = (
        ttm_filtered()
        .groupby([grid_id_header, "geometry", demo_col], dropna=False, as_index=False)[
            travel_metric_header
        ]
        .min()
    )
    grouped.loc[np.isinf(grouped[travel_metric_header]), travel_metric_header] = np.nan

    threshold = input.distance_band_km()
    if input.show_outside():
        mask = grouped[travel_metric_header].isna() | (grouped[travel_metric_header] > threshold)
    else:
        mask = grouped[travel_metric_header].notna() & (grouped[travel_metric_header] <= threshold)

    return grouped.loc[mask].copy()


@reactive.calc
def n_health_facilities() -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = filtered_healthcare()
    if df.empty:
        return pd.DataFrame(columns=[facility_type_col_header, "n"])
    return healthcare.facility_type.value_counts()


@reactive.calc
def pop_summary() -> pd.DataFrame:
    ttm = ttm_gdf
    demo_col = input.demographic()
    threshold = input.distance_band_km()
    types = selected_facility_types()

    if input.admin_area() == "National":
        filtered = ttm.loc[
            ttm[facility_type_col_header].isin(types) | ttm[facility_type_col_header].isna()
        ].drop_duplicates()
        relevant_pop_gdf = pop_gdf
    else:
        filtered = ttm.loc[
            (ttm[admin_area_col_header] == input.admin_area())
            & (ttm[facility_type_col_header].isin(types) | ttm[facility_type_col_header].isna())
        ]
        relevant_pop_gdf = pop_gdf.loc[
            (ttm[admin_area_col_header] == input.admin_area())
        ]

    with_facility = filtered.loc[filtered[facility_type_col_header].notna(), [grid_id_header, demo_col, travel_metric_header]]
    with_facility = (
        with_facility.groupby(grid_id_header, as_index=False)
        .agg({demo_col: "first", travel_metric_header:"min"})
    )

    no_facility = filtered.loc[
        filtered[facility_type_col_header].isna() & ~filtered[grid_id_header].isin(with_facility[grid_id_header]),
        [grid_id_header, demo_col, travel_metric_header],
    ].drop_duplicates()

    combined = pd.concat([no_facility, with_facility], ignore_index=True)
    combined.loc[np.isinf(combined[travel_metric_header]), travel_metric_header] = np.nan
    combined = combined.rename(columns={demo_col: "population_col"})

    band = input.distance_band_km()
    combined["distance"] = np.where(
        combined[travel_metric_header].notna() & (combined[travel_metric_header] <= threshold),
        f"Within {band}km",
        f"Outside {band}km",
    )

    # when ttm_gdf is generated from a merge with distance df, any population cells
    # in excess of the max travel time/distance are excluded. However these are relevant 
    # again when calculating population totals. We reintroduce them again here: 
    excluded_pop_cells_df = pd.merge(
        combined, relevant_pop_gdf, left_on="grid_id", right_on="id", how="right"
    )[
        pd.merge(
            combined, pop_gdf, left_on="grid_id", right_on="id", how="right"
        ).distance.isna()
    ]
    excluded_pop_sum = excluded_pop_cells_df[demo_col].sum()
    missing_data = {
        "grid_id": ["XXX"],
        "population_col": [excluded_pop_sum],
        "travel_distance": [f"Outside {band}km"],
        "distance": [f"Outside {band}km"],
    }
    df_new_rows = pd.DataFrame(missing_data)
    combined = pd.concat([combined, df_new_rows])

    out = combined.groupby("distance", as_index=False)["population_col"].sum(min_count=1)
    total = out["population_col"].sum() 
    if total and not np.isnan(total):
        out["percent"] = np.round((out["population_col"] / total) * 100, 1)
    else:
        out["percent"] = 0.0
    return out

```

# Home {orientation="columns"}

## Map {width="75%"}

```{python}

@render.text
def map_title() -> str:
    if input.show_outside():
        return f"Population outside {input.distance_band_km()}km of selected health facilities"
    return f"Population within {input.distance_band_km()}km of selected health facilities"

@render.ui
def map_view():
    district_gdf = selected_district()
    district_gdf = district_gdf.to_crs(visualisation_crs)

    req(not district_gdf.empty)

    points = gpd.GeoDataFrame(point_population()).to_crs(visualisation_crs)
    demo_col = input.demographic()

    bounds = district_gdf.total_bounds
    center_lat = (bounds[1] + bounds[3]) / 2
    center_lon = (bounds[0] + bounds[2]) / 2

    m = folium.Map(location=[center_lat, center_lon], tiles="OpenStreetMap", zoom_start=8)

    folium.GeoJson(
        district_gdf.__geo_interface__,
        style_function=lambda _: {"color": "black", "weight": 2, "fillOpacity": 0.0},
        name="Admin Area",
    ).add_to(m)

    if not points.empty and demo_col in points.columns:
        pop_vals = points[demo_col].astype(float)
        pop_vals = pop_vals[(~pop_vals.isna()) & (pop_vals > 0)]

        if not pop_vals.empty:

            log_vals = np.log10(pop_vals)
            cmap = linear.viridis.scale(-1, float(log_vals.max()))
            cmap.caption = f"Estimated population ({demo_col}, log10 scale)"
            cmap.add_to(m)

            if input.admin_area() == "National":
                for _, row in points.iterrows():
                    value = row.get(demo_col)
                    if pd.isna(value) or value <= 0 or pd.isna(row.get("geometry")):
                        continue
                    color = cmap(float(np.log10(value)))
                    folium.CircleMarker(
                        location=[row.geometry.centroid.y, row.geometry.centroid.x],
                        radius=2,
                        color=color,
                        fill=True,
                        fill_color=color,
                        fill_opacity=0.75,
                        weight=0,
                    ).add_to(m)
            else:
                points_vis = points[points[demo_col].notna() & (points[demo_col] > 0)].copy()
                points_vis["log_val"] = np.log10(points_vis[demo_col].astype(float))

                folium.GeoJson(
                    points_vis.__geo_interface__,
                    style_function=lambda feature: {
                        "fillColor": cmap(feature["properties"]["log_val"]),
                        "color": "none",
                        "weight": 0,
                        "fillOpacity": 0.75,
                    },
                    name="Population",
                ).add_to(m)

    facilities = gpd.GeoDataFrame(filtered_healthcare())
    facilities = facilities.to_crs(visualisation_crs)
    for _, row in facilities.iterrows():
        if pd.isna(row.get("geometry")):
            continue
        popup = row.get("popup", "")
        folium.Marker(
            location=[row.geometry.y, row.geometry.x],
            tooltip=popup,
            icon=folium.Icon(color="blue", icon="hospital", prefix="fa"),
        ).add_to(m)

    m.fit_bounds([[bounds[1], bounds[0]], [bounds[3], bounds[2]]])
    return ui.HTML(m._repr_html_())



```

### Population proportion

```{python}

@reactive.calc
def title_percent_within() -> str:
    if input.show_outside():
        return f"% of estimated population outside {input.distance_band_km()}km"
    return f"% of estimated population within {input.distance_band_km()}km"


@reactive.calc
def percent_within() -> str:
    band = input.distance_band_km()
    label = f"Outside {band}km" if input.show_outside() else f"Within {band}km"
    summary = pop_summary()
    row = summary.loc[summary["distance"] == label, "percent"]
    value = float(row.iloc[0]) if not row.empty else 0.0
    return f"{value:.1f}%"

@render.ui
def percentage_info_box():
    return ui.value_box(
        title=title_percent_within(),
        value=percent_within(),
        showcase_layout="top right",
        theme=ui.value_box_theme(bg="#e6f2fd", fg="#0B538E"),
    )
```

### Estimated population count

```{python}
@reactive.calc
def title_n_outside() -> str:
    if input.show_outside():
        return f"Estimated population beyond {input.distance_band_km()}km"
    return f"Estimated population within {input.distance_band_km()}km"


@reactive.calc
def n_outside() -> str:
    band = input.distance_band_km()
    label = f"Outside {band}km" if input.show_outside() else f"Within {band}km"
    summary = pop_summary()
    row = summary.loc[summary["distance"] == label, "population_col"]
    value = float(row.iloc[0]) if not row.empty else 0.0
    return f"{int(round(value)):,}"

@render.ui
def n_pop_outside_box():
    return ui.value_box(
        title=title_n_outside(),
        value=n_outside(),
        showcase_layout="top right",
        theme=ui.value_box_theme(bg="#e6f2fd", fg="#0B538E"),
    )
```

# About


**User interface**

This [Shiny](https://shiny.posit.co/) application enables the user to identify estimated populations that reside beyond a user defined distance of a health facility. The dropdown menus allow users to select individual subnational areas or the whole of the country. Healthcare facilities can be selected by type, for example: hospital, clinic, dispensary, private and unclassified. It also possible to choose estimated populations by subgroup:

- Females
- Males
- Children (0-14)
- Working-age adults (15-64)
- Older people (65+)
- Women of reproductive age (15-49)

Finally users can toggle between estimated populations that live *within* and *outside* the chosen distance of a healthcare facility.

The map will automatically zoom to the area of interest and update summary statistics in the right panel.

**Datasets**

The following datasets were used in the application:

|Name |Source |URL |Type |Licence |
|:-----|:-----|:-----|:-----|:-----|
|Administrative boundaries |[geoBoundaries](https://www.geoboundaries.org/countryDownloads.html) |[Link](https://www.geoboundaries.org/countryDownloads.html)  |`.GeoJSON`  |[Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License](http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0) |
|Healthcare facilities |[healthsites.io](https://healthsites.io/) | [Link](https://data.humdata.org/dataset) |`.GeoJSON`  |[Open Database License](https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/) |
|Population estimates |[WorldPop](https://www.worldpop.org/) | [Link](https://www.worldpop.org/datacatalog/) |`.tif` |[Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License](http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0) |
|Road network |[OpenStreetMap (OSM)](ttps://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Overpass_API) | [Link](https://overpass-api.de/) |`.pbf` |[ODbL](https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/) |

**Method**

A distance matrix was derived from a travel time matrix calculated using the [`r5py`](https://r5py.readthedocs.io/stable/) Python package which interfaces with the [R<sup>5</sup>](https://github.com/conveyal/r5) routing engine. The shortest distances along the road network between origin (healthcare facilities) and destination (gridded population estimates) pairs were identified and visualised in the application. Full details of the methodology can be found in the accompanying GitHub repo.
